persons.name: Devīdhara
persons.evidence: idaṃ puṣṭakaṃ likhitaṃ tacapālaṭola basnyā devīdharavatās

date.as_written: samvat 1942 sāla miti śrāvaṇa śu di 10 roja 5

notes: Tacapāla-ṭola (Tachapal) is a well-known quarter in Bhaktapur. The phrasing 'tacapālaṭola basnyā devīdharavatās' uses Nepali ('basnyā' = resident; 'devīdharavatās' likely representing devīdharabāṭa or an honorific form).
